name: comprehendmedical
description: Amazon Comprehend Medical extracts structured information from unstructured clinical text.

subcommands.name: describe-entities-detection-v2-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a medical entities detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-icd10-cm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with an InferICD10CM job.

subcommands.name: describe-phi-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a protected health information (PHI) detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-rx-norm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with an InferRxNorm job.

subcommands.name: describe-snomedct-inference-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with an InferSNOMEDCT job.

subcommands.name: detect-entities
subcommands.description: The DetectEntities operation is deprecated.

subcommands.name: detect-entities-v2
subcommands.description: Inspects the clinical text for a variety of medical entities and returns specific information about them such as entity category, location, and confidence score on that information.

subcommands.name: detect-phi
subcommands.description: Inspects the clinical text for protected health information (PHI) entities and returns the entity category, location, and confidence score for each entity.

subcommands.name: infer-icd10-cm
subcommands.description: InferICD10CM detects medical conditions as entities listed in a patient record and links those entities to normalized concept identifiers in the ICD-10-CM knowledge base from the Centers for Disease Control.

subcommands.name: infer-rx-norm
subcommands.description: InferRxNorm detects medications as entities listed in a patient record and links to the normalized concept identifiers in the RxNorm database from the National Library of Medicine.

subcommands.name: infer-snomedct
subcommands.description: InferSNOMEDCT detects possible medical concepts as entities and links them to codes from the Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine, Clinical Terms (SNOMED-CT) ontology

subcommands.name: list-entities-detection-v2-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of medical entity detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-icd10-cm-inference-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of InferICD10CM jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-phi-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of protected health information (PHI) detection jobs you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-rx-norm-inference-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of InferRxNorm jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-snomedct-inference-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of InferSNOMEDCT jobs a user has submitted.

subcommands.name: start-entities-detection-v2-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous medical entity detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-icd10-cm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous job to detect medical conditions and link them to the ICD-10-CM ontology.

subcommands.name: start-phi-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous job to detect protected health information (PHI).

subcommands.name: start-rx-norm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous job to detect medication entities and link them to the RxNorm ontology.

subcommands.name: start-snomedct-inference-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous job to detect medical concepts and link them to the SNOMED-CT ontology.

subcommands.name: stop-entities-detection-v2-job
subcommands.description: Stops a medical entities detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-icd10-cm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Stops an InferICD10CM inference job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-phi-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a protected health information (PHI) detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-rx-norm-inference-job
subcommands.description: Stops an InferRxNorm inference job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-snomedct-inference-job
subcommands.description: Stops an InferSNOMEDCT inference job in progress.
